historical_references.reference: Brahma Purana mentions a sage named Bahuratha, who was a great devotee of Lord Vishnu and had attained a thousand arms (Bahumanya).
Another reference to Bahumanya can be found in the Mahabharata where he is mentioned as the father of Bhima, the strongest of the Pandava brothers.
